title: Learned items with provenance in the newsroom console
description:
Ryan committed (2026-10-21) to building learned items with provenance in the newsroom console. An editor reads, in plain words, everything a Cyclotron learned about the publication. Each item shows the approvals, rejections and notes behind it (e.g. 'From 12 approvals · 1 note'); every suggestion says which items and questions drove it. Editors edit, remove or add items, which go live only after measurement and an editor's promote.
Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Jg1DpixLFcAvnPy7d9RNDE. Design: https://claude.ai/artifact/KzDCSDwgKos3iWjbm1oubz section 6. Tied to Cyclotron milestones M1–M4; the Cyclotron epic is filed on the Cyclotron board by the Cyclotron session. Ends with p.apyr.us documentation (Papyrus rule).
